# Probity AI

> Tools and run records for checking claims about agent actions.

## Guides

- [Choose a project](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/start.html): Tools grouped by the task you need.
- [Automation](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/automation.html): Read the catalog and pinned run records.
- [Open Evidence Lab](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/lab.html): Retained runs, submissions and corrections.
- [Assurance atlas](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/atlas.html): Projects, mechanisms and evidence boundaries.
- [Experiments](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/experiments.html): Pinned procedures and recorded results.
- [Claim ledger](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/claims.html): Sources and re-derive commands.
- [Repository guide](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/repository.html): Sources, checks and the site build.

## Projects

- [Probity Admission](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-admission/blob/dd0857aea19283185f27a19d07a5c3257ae31ec6/README.md): Provides OPA, Kyverno and policy-controller rules for consumer-pinned execution evidence.
- [Probity Atlas](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-atlas/blob/3109ae4be7dca77594fa7ddba8565d7feb261cf9/README.md): Documents agent assurance claims and provides an Open Evidence Lab run register.
- [dsse](https://github.com/probityai/dsse/blob/f6f6df4bef5544af76dc3f5b05909a2f24a8e51f/README.md): Signs and verifies DSSE envelopes with explicit threshold and key handling.
- [jcs-admit](https://github.com/probityai/jcs-admit/blob/ecc8b5ef4b380a2fe38e5079d128307a1c702717/README.md): Checks raw JSON input before producing its RFC 8785 canonical form.
- [Probity Observer](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-observer/blob/8c074d7b8f380dd01fd55277b68a37ad8217c8cb/README.md): Records brokered file requests and includes an offline reader for selected native delegation runs.
- [Probity Vectors](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/bbdef583c9241138e5c2b5d872bc77f7f539e9ac/README.md): Provides conformance cases and reference verifiers for selected agent evidence formats.
- [Probity Verify](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/e835ce2bd6a960e7a1cc2fa6522f16d55dce728a/README.md): Checks supplied evidence bytes through claim-specific offline adapters.
- [Probity Vocabulary](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/blob/8c80579ae613d7ae07982321e13a6091c402b2a8/README.md): Defines versioned terms and crosswalks for claims about agent execution.

## Data

- [Project catalog](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/catalog.json): Stable project IDs, tasks and pinned README sources.
- [Lab register](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/lab/register.json): Retained artifacts, results and review state.
